in_sanskrit.name: वैकुंथ
in_sanskrit.meaning: Sky or heaven filled with bliss
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: वै (vai) - all, कुंथ (kunth) - sky, filled, heaven. So, Baikunth means a sky or heaven filled with bliss.

in_hindi.name: वैकुंथ
in_hindi.meaning: समस्या से मुक्त राहें वापस लाने वाला
in_hindi.long_meaning: वै (vai) - समस्या (problem), कुंथ (kunth) - उत्पत्ति (origination), वाला (vala) - one who brings back. So, Baikunth means one who brings back solutions to problems.

in_tamil.name: வைகுந்த
in_tamil.meaning: வாய் (vai) - all, குஞ்சி (kunth) - sky, filled, heaven. So, Baikunth means a sky or heaven filled with bliss.

in_telugu.name: వైకుంఠ
in_telugu.long_meaning: వై (vai) - శ్శోదర్ (supreme), కుంఠ (kunth) - మూదేశపూజీ (deity of the mind), So, Baikunth means the supreme deity of the mind.

in_marathi.name: Baikunth
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Celestial abode of Vishnu
in_marathi.long_meaning: Baikunth हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Baikunth is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Vaikuntha' or 'Baikuntha'. It refers to the celestial abode of Lord Vishnu, where the souls of the virtuous go after death. This name is believed to bring blessings of prosperity, peace, and spiritual growth.

in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Celestial abode of Vishnu
in_bengali.long_meaning: Baikunth একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Baikunth is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Vaikuntha' or 'Baikuntha'. It refers to the celestial abode of Lord Vishnu, where the souls of the virtuous go after death. This name is believed to bring blessings of prosperity, peace, and spiritual growth.
